description: Add a texting line. Received texts on it can join Summer conversations. The line starts off; nothing is sent. Fast replies follow the texting channel's autonomy setting.

escalation_style.description: check_back (default): 'Let me check and get back to you.' manager: may say it is checking with a manager.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

ingest_phone_number_ids.description: Other Quo lines, from available_lines, whose received texts join this line's conversations. Replies always go out from this line. Replaces the whole list; [] stops taking texts from other lines.

installation_id.description: Messenger installation whose assistant instructions and knowledge the line uses. Defaults to the first installation.

persona_mode.description: human: a person on the team (default). ai: a visible AI assistant.

persona_name.description: The name the assistant texts as, such as Alex.

quo_phone_number_id.description: The Quo line ID, from available_lines in messenger.sms.read.

reply_end_hour.description: Hour the assistant stops texting, in the customer's local time. Default 23.

reply_start_hour.description: First hour the assistant may text, in the customer's local time. Default 5.

name: summer_messenger_sms_create
title: Add a texting line
